extracted.summary: An initiative providing financial support to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to help them complete school education.
extracted.amount_text: INR 1,000 per month for a year
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have scored at least 55% marks, or 50% for SC and ST, in their Class VII exams to qualify for the selection test.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: The parental income must not exceed INR 3,50,000 per annum.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Students from any community studying in Government, Government-aided, or local body schools are eligible.
